items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Art was playing the piano. We'll go over there and tell him to play something and let you play with him.

ctx.x: He says, can you read music? I said, yeah. He says, can you fake music? I said, yes. He says, can you fake music? I said, yes. He says, go play something for me. I said, I can't. I said, the piano player's playing. Art was playing the piano. We'll go over there and tell him to play something and let you play with him. So I said, alright. So I went over there. I said, alright. I said, you want to accompany me for playing something? Yeah, yeah. I said, go ahead and play. So we started playing. After I got finished,…
